summary: Rapid advancements in **artificial intelligence** and **automation** are driving society toward a **post-labor economy** where human workers will largely be replaced by machines and advanced computing infrastructure. As traditional labor loses its security and economic value, power and wealth will concentrate among a **small ruling elite** who control critical physical and digital assets like data centers, energy grids, and AI systems. To avoid becoming part of a disenfranchised **permanent underclass**, individuals must urgently transition from trading their time for wages to actively **acquiring tangible assets**, building audience distribution, and embedding themselves within **durable business networks**.
